ul.li: If the claim is continuing, go to step 10.
If the claim is renewal, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is an outstanding registration number for the out of Canada issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 11.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim requiring the D60 to be imposed.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Payment System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “D60: [start and end date of disentitlement]”
Remarks line 2: If required, type other information or changes needed (including claimant’s reports, if necessary).
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Go to step 15.

step.cmd: In NWS, create a client Note and type “Disentitlement information for out of Canada has to be input as per ROD dated [date]. Please include information in MM06 to IPOC. Send saved ACS letter.”
In ACS, create and send (continuing claim) or create and save (renewal claim) the D-60-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Indefinite disentitlement start date (1270) has expired / will expire (3989): Select has expired .
Select the appropriate option.
